projects.title: Budget Tracker
projects.summary: A mobile budgeting app built for simplicity: anyone, from a first-time earner to a pensioner, should be able to set up a budget in 5–10 minutes.

facts.label: Stack
facts.value: React Native · TypeScript · Expo · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL

goal.title: The goal
goal.text: Budgeting should take minutes, not an afternoon. Budget Tracker is built so that someone who has never made a budget can set one up in 5–10 minutes, and keep using it.
